interpretation_limit: Confidence is not guaranteed correctness.

what_it_is: Bounded diagnostic interpretation ledger.
interpretation_limit: Interpretations must remain linked to quantitative checks.

what_it_is: Development subgroup/support/feature-quality performance.
interpretation_limit: Diagnostic, not independent discoveries.

what_it_is: Evidence-linked claim/result/interpretation/alternatives/nonclaim/next-evidence ledger.
interpretation_limit: Synthesis is not a new independent dataset.

what_it_is: Eligibility records for fixed high-support example selection.
interpretation_limit: No eligible examples; do not lower thresholds after seeing results.

what_it_is: Frozen-test confidence-grid coverage, accuracy, utility and cluster intervals.
interpretation_limit: Post-test thresholds not optimized; utility includes abstentions in denominator.

what_it_is: Shared semantic-discriminating pairs and matched per-group support.
interpretation_limit: No adequately supported matched pair-group contrasts.

what_it_is: Development demographic semantic-trait discriminating comparison rates.
interpretation_limit: Unadjusted different-pair composition; no causal demographic preferences.

what_it_is: Development demographic support table/figure.
interpretation_limit: Support is operational, not a power guarantee.

what_it_is: Exact linear feature contributions for recorded validation examples.
interpretation_limit: Explains a model prediction, not a causal human preference.

what_it_is: Pre-review automated feature coverage and successful extraction summary.
interpretation_limit: Use admission decisions for final reviewed status.

what_it_is: Fitting photo/cat undirected and directed connectivity statistics.
interpretation_limit: Penalized finiteness differs from unpenalized BT MLE existence.

what_it_is: Refitted H/Y feature-group-drop development comparisons.
interpretation_limit: Conditional predictive value, not percentage of behavior caused by features.

what_it_is: All learning-curve fitting/tuning candidates.
interpretation_limit: Additional development tuning; not primary-test candidates.

what_it_is: Support/reference/fallback changes across nested fitting subsets.
interpretation_limit: Effective interaction models change as sample support changes.

what_it_is: Nested fitting-size results on one common eligible validation population.
interpretation_limit: Not full validation population or an information-limit estimate.

what_it_is: Matched frozen test metrics, uncertainty, fit/validation and resource columns.
interpretation_limit: Point-model ranking does not establish every paired difference.

what_it_is: Stored coefficient/backbone counts and scoped fitting/inference timings.
interpretation_limit: Counts are not effective degrees of freedom; timings exclude specified IO/extraction.

what_it_is: Mutually exclusive official target overlap against all labeled training rows.
interpretation_limit: Unlabeled target coverage; no official performance.

what_it_is: Official target structure and fitting graph/feature availability.
interpretation_limit: Unlabeled target coverage; no official performance.

what_it_is: In-sample empirical canonical pair entropy summaries.
interpretation_limit: Not an oracle, information limit or held-out predictor.

what_it_is: Development canonical pair proportions, support and Wilson intervals.
interpretation_limit: Working-model intervals; tiny support; no respondent linkage.

what_it_is: Pair support distributions by development subset and comparison type.
interpretation_limit: Sparse support does not identify a human randomness mechanism.

what_it_is: Reproduced registered penalty paths and fit/validation scores.
interpretation_limit: No post-test penalty-grid expansion.

what_it_is: Unique photo response/opponent support by development subset.
interpretation_limit: Repeated photos induce dependence; counts are not respondents.

what_it_is: Selected CNN weight deviations by pet-care group against reference.
interpretation_limit: CNN coordinates lack individual semantic labels.

what_it_is: Signed frozen H/Y coefficients selected for presentation.
interpretation_limit: Scaling/coding affect magnitudes; not standalone importance or causality.

what_it_is: Four prespecified paired contrasts with approximate 98.75% intervals.
interpretation_limit: Conditional unordered-pair bootstrap omits other dependence and training variability.

what_it_is: Ridge recovery of estimated fitting-photo M2 scores by H/C/Y.
interpretation_limit: Estimated, noisy in-sample targets; not independent human preference ground truth.

what_it_is: Context/side/position/temperature secondary paired contrasts.
interpretation_limit: 95% pointwise intervals unadjusted for secondary multiplicity.

what_it_is: Eligible response/pair counts by partition and comparison type.
interpretation_limit: Coverage is operational, not a power guarantee.

what_it_is: User-authorized individual contribution/presentation placeholders.
interpretation_limit: Not certified actual completed contributions.

what_it_is: Frozen-test comparison-type, context, support and quality subgroup metrics.
interpretation_limit: Low-support slices cannot support strong subgroup conclusions.

what_it_is: Independent fair-coin fitting/validation controls at fixed procedures.
interpretation_limit: Passing an operational control is not a universal leakage certificate.

what_it_is: Validation-selected fixed temperature grid diagnostic.
interpretation_limit: Secondary; must not select using internal-test results.

what_it_is: Frozen-test probability bins, observed frequencies, counts and support flags.
interpretation_limit: Bin estimates are noisy; calibration is not information completeness.

what_it_is: Software/checkpoint/dataset resources and distribution restrictions.
interpretation_limit: Not blanket legal/license clearance.

what_it_is: Saved matched validation predictions for reconstruction and diagnosis.
interpretation_limit: Validation was used for selection.

what_it_is: Selected-model development losses and penalties.
interpretation_limit: Selection evidence, not held-out test performance.

what_it_is: Recorded worst-loss validation cases and comparisons.
interpretation_limit: Examples explain model errors, not representative causal effects.
